items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: Snooky Young stood next to me on Louie Bellson’s band for a long time and he was also, we were in Bill Berry’s band together and also in the Juggernaut, Nat Pierce/Frank Capp band together.

ctx.x: Well for me, I was on Gerald’s band playing the lead chair for a while, and then Snooky Young stood next to me on Louie Bellson’s band for a long time and he was also, we were in Bill Berry’s band together and also in the Juggernaut, Nat Pierce/Frank Capp band together. I love Snooky. My three favorite lead trumpet players in the world are Snooky, Al Porcino and Conrad Gozzo. Anybody that’s going to learn to play lead trumpet better study those three guys because everybody else comes from those three.

items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But it was a heck of a trumpet section; we enjoyed playing with one another.

ctx.x: I played in his band, man. He‘s Louie, I played in his band, it was five trumpets in there. Now, I‘m going to name the trumpets. We had a little thing where we, the name was; Stew, Shew, Blue, Cool—I can‘t think of that last one. Stew is…Cool is…Blue is Blue Mitchell, Snoo is Snooky. Cool…oh, wait a minute. It was quite a thing, man, we had, all five of us had a name. I don‘t know why we got into that. But it was a heck of a trumpet section; we enjoyed playing with one another. Now what was; Stew, Blue, Woo…I…
